title: Membership of every binary vector
statement: For every nonnegative integer $\ell$, every vector $x \in (\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^\ell$ occurs in the list formed recursively from the unique zero-dimensional vector by prefixing each vector at dimension $\ell$ by both possible bits to form the list at dimension $\ell+1$.
